name: BuddenBench
description:
BuddenBench: A Benchmark of Open Nontrivial Mathematics Research Problems
	

This benchmark, affectionately named budden-bench, measures the ability of models and agents to autonomously solve open and important problems in mathematics research. In contrast to other problem sets such as the Erdős Problems, this benchmark is intended to exclusively contain problems which are of ongoing research interest to working mathematicians.
